name: Three Seconds Snakes 2018
information:
The competitor limit is 80. The registration fee is $20. The venue is located at Peter J. Palombi Middle School.

If you register and cannot attend, please contact us immediately. If you contact us before April 14th, you will be elligeble for a full refund. However, If you contact us after April 14th you will only be elligeble for a 50% refund.
